classification: dividend ETF data-availability and integrity probe only; no returns inspected

decision_rule.action_if_fail: record data gap and do not test the dividend component
decision_rule.action_if_pass: cache both adjusted series for R331 only; no return calculation in R330
decision_rule.missing_calendar_rate: <=5% from each asset first date through as_of
decision_rule.primary_liquidity: median daily amount >= CNY 100m and minimum 20-day average amount >= CNY 50m

known_limitations: ETF qfq history is vendor-reconstructed, not an official point-in-time archive.
Availability is tested before performance; this probe does not choose an allocation weight.
